note: The Daily Trips map's data, slimmed from out/full-map/ by scripts/daily-trips-site.py. Per populated 2020 census block, in blocks.json's order: residents; muni, how often one route comes at a stop within a quarter mile on foot, 7 to 9 AM (5, 10 or 0 for less often or none); stop, walking feet to the nearest stop and to the nearest with one route every 5 minutes then; min, whole minutes rounded up per type and mode; tthird, the transit minutes on the faster T Third feed. Outlines as site/src/maplibre.mjs's encodeRuns, with shape giving each block's rings per polygon.

end_to_end_min.why: Sunnydale to Chinatown in about 35 minutes (the feed's peak trips take 45 to 48), roughly what full signal priority would give

headway_min.why: a T every 5 minutes all day, both directions (the feed runs every 10 in the AM peak)

pattern.value: every trip full length; the feed's short turns removed

scaling.why: every stop-to-stop time and dwell scaled by end_to_end_min over the template's duration

span.value: the feed's first to last T departure that day, per direction
